text:
ana (sre): quick follow-up thread for intermittent cross-region TLS failures observed during morning deploys (us-west -> eu-west). opening for action tracking.

lb-bot: alert: route_error_rate high on /v1/predict at 2026-03-20T09:22:00Z  5xx spikes and TLS alerts

tom (networking): initial triage shows connection resets timed with route-manager leader switch. possible short window where new route table points to LB without updated cert.

jess (eng-runtime): logs show TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure) and occasional "certificate unknown" entries. attaching minimal sample.

ana (sre): typo, meant ana above :)

ana (sre): action F1: collect 20m tcpdump on egress-gw-us-west and capture route-manager leader-change event logs. owner: ana. ETA: 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC.

tom (networking): action F2: run cert-roll audit for eu region to detect partial rollout windows. owner: tom. ETA: 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC.

jess (eng-runtime): mitigation F3: temporarily extend cert-roll overlap window to avoid serving before routing fully converges. owner: jess. ETA: 2026-03-21 12:00 UTC. will roll config to 0 -> 100% in 15m.

ravi (cloud-eng): action F4: open provider ticket for observed NAT churn during leader elections; request traceroutes and NAT port usage counters. owner: ravi. ETA: 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC.

support: created ticket TIX-6123 for impacted customers; product will assemble impact summary.

ana (sre): added metric tls.cross_region.handshake_failures and dashboard; alert threshold set to 8/min.

jess (eng-runtime): note: KV cache warms slower during leader switch; might amplify handshake timing. adding to Optimize triage.

tom (networking): uploaded filtered pcap (09:20-09:30) and short notes. link in thread.

ana (sre): scheduling sync 2026-03-21 13:00 UTC to review pcaps and provider reply. please leave artifacts here. marking this thread as canonical follow-up for the incident. :white_check_mark:
